description: THE headline money report for a date range — the same numbers as Reports → Financial Summary. Answers 'how much did we make last week', 'what were sales this month', 'how much tax do I owe', 'what lands in my bank'. Returns gross sales, discounts, refunds, fees, tax, tips, net sales, and the settlement split (card / cash / custom) down to what the merchant actually receives. Start here for any "how did the business do" question, and only reach for get_sales_breakdown when the merchant wants the individual orders behind these totals.
